text: Ahmed Samir Farag (Arabic: أحمد سمير فرج; born 20 May 1986) is an Egyptian footballer who plays for El-Daklyeh and the Egyptian national football team. He primarily plays as a left back but is also capable of playing as a left midfielder or left winger. In June 2008, Farag was selected for the Egypt national football team and featured in the line-up for five matches during the 2010 World Cup Qualifiers, making his debut against Congo DR on 1 June 2008. He was part of the Egypt national under-21 football team in two consecutive World Youth Cups: the 2005 tournament held in the Netherlands and the 2003 tournament in the UAE. Following his performance in 2003, Farag signed his first professional contract with FC Sochaux-Montbéliard at the age of 17, transferring from Al Ahly in Egypt. He was nominated for Young Player of the Year in Africa in 2005. In 2011, he won the best player award at the Nile Basin Tournament in Egypt. On 27 February 2014, he joined Zamalek SC for a period of 2 and a half years.[citation needed]
